573-1238-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
573-1238-8323-8324.description:
Play Gruul Turf
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

6529-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4359-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4687-5268-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three counters on it.
4687-5268-5479.description:
Activate Utopia Vow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

339-677-728-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4875-5310-6495-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5310-6495-6879.notes:
If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

483-997-1981-2415.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5231-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5231-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5231-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

1017-7687-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-7687-7690.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Fantastic.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1017-7687-7690.notes: If you control other Heroes, you can place the +1/+1 counter on any of those Heroes instead.

500-851-2523-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

3484-5391-5902-7824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-5902-7824.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2292-7038-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1394-2060-2292-7038-7803.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Brad Boimler.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Brad Boimler.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

643-4302-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3362-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Omni-Changeling's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

3713-5078-5268-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3967-5310-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

573-5478-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5478-5702-6850.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-3470-6975.notablePrerequisites: There are at least eight lands between the battlefield under your control and your hand, four or which enter untapped and can tap to produce at least {4}.
1401-3470-6975.description:
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} plus commander tax if applicable, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding Multani to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered this way.
Activate at least four lands that enter untapped by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Multani's ability by paying {1}{G} and returning two lands to your hand.
Repeat step 4 at least once, and more times if desired.
Resolve all Multani abilities, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1401-3470-6975.notes: You can repeat step 4 to bounce other lands, but you must bounce lands in multiples of two. All lands bounced this way will be placed onto the battlefield again by Journey to the Oracle.

38-4740-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
38-4740-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

962-1247-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Yurlok of Scorch Thrash's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2239-4558-6798.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2239-4558-6798.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1753-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

3875-5702-5954-6753.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3875-5702-5954-6753.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3875-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens. 
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1374-3626-5499-6633--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-6633--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2292-3139--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
The sacrificed creature's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to draw a card.
The -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

261-1274-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-1274-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-5220-5231--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-5220-5231--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Repeat.
866-5220-5231--66.notes: You can use a creature that has at most one {R} in its mana cost - although the combo will not produce red mana, and you will need {R} to start.

220-428-1692-1946.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
220-428-1692-1946.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn.
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 3 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 14, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn token trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 14, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 14 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of the token Ghyrson Starn.
Repeat from step 14.

141-4050-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-4050-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

277-1227-3476-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
277-1227-3476-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Phantatog ability from step 2, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

703-2896-4753.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attaching Necromancy to Astral Dragon.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Necromancy tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, with at least one trigger targeting Clever Impersonator.
Resolve the first Necromancy trigger, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Astral Dragon, and not attaching Necromancy to Clever Impersonator due to Necromancy being a creature.
The Necromancy Aura creature token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to being an Aura that is unattached.
The Necromancy token leaves-the-battlefield ability triggers, as well as Clever Impersonator's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Necromancy trigger, causing you to sacrifce Clever Impersonator.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, creating two token copies of Necromancy that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

136-2945-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {B}.
Cadaver Imp dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Liliana, Heretical Healer.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Liliana, Heretical Healer trigger, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield transformed, and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana, Defiant Necromancer is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana, Defiant Necromancer ability, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie token, adding {B}.
The Zombie dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Liliana, Heretical Healer by paying {1}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-2544.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
198-2544.notes: You can start the combo with fewer charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator if you supply extra mana.

1261-2752.notablePrerequisites: Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1261-2752.description:
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{U} and tapping it, untap Time Vault.
Activate Time Vault by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

43-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
43-5261.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to cast a copy of the exiled instant.
Paradox Engine triggers, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of the instant.
Repeat.
If nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.
